easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
description:
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of Burning-Tree Emissary with haste.
When Burning-Tree Emissary enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Burning-Tree Emissary token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Burning-Tree Emissary token dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Jaxis.
Repeat.
